content: I was on Twitter and I noticed the official "leanprover" account was shilling a cryptocoin https://x.com/leanprover/status/2080749130264244569 here. Is anyone aware? We might want to edit the website to point away from this account for the time being.

It seems to have been inadvertent rather than a hack: https://x.com/Leonard41111588/status/2080986367815827528?s=20

The original tweet didn't read like a plug or endorsement (it's gone now), they probably included $LEAN thinking it was an innocuous signal booster.
